Exploitability_explanation: Thorough search of the codebase (src/, test/, scripts/) found no explicit calls to vulnerable node-tar APIs (tar.x, tar.extract, etc.). The library is present only as a transitive devDependency. Status: not_confirmed.
Ajv is a devDependency used by ESLint. No explicit calls to new Ajv() or ajv.validate() with $data enabled were found in segments of the codebase. Status: not_confirmed.
Flatted is a devDependency for testing tools. No calls to flatted.parse() or flatted.stringify() were found in the project's source code or active paths. Status: not_confirmed.
Path traversal via symlinks on Windows is not reachable as the tar library is not invoked in any active code path within the shelljs repository. Status: not_confirmed.
Prototype pollution via flatted.parse() is not exploitable as the library is not used in the application logic and no calls to the vulnerable API exist. Status: not_confirmed.
